selection: Within the predeclared80 IDs, all and only executed TRUE/FALSE programs; no source-correctness or inline-answer filtering.
input: Only roots/equations/observed/intervention/target/desired and the existing native IR execution instruction; no original question/explanation/inline answer/source gold/execution result.
interpretation: Status match tests executing the same compiled IR; source accuracy also depends on compilation. All comparisons are limited to this method-specific eligible subset.
costs: Additional diagnostic calls, separate from the deployed one-call head and causal_steps control.
